BiblicalUsage: Jerah is an Arabian patriarch, a son of Joktan. In Genesis 10:26, Hazarmaveth, and Jerah. The fuller story is told on the Jerah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jerah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
